exposure: Maternal GDM treatment (diet only vs. diet and insulin therapy)
COVID-19 pandemic outbreak period (2020 vs. other years)
cohort: The study analyzed medical records of 646 newborns born at term or near term between 2017 and 2021 to mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM).
finding: Newborns of mothers treated for GDM with diet only versus diet and insulin therapy differed significantly in length of hospitalisation, incidence of cardiological abnormalities, and feeding method, while neonates born in 2020 (during the COVID-19 pandemic) more often required adaptation support and were diagnosed with birth defects.
